description: Build a token metadata data URI from structured input. Returns the complete metadataURI for the launch tool, the normalized manifest (as renderers see it), byte size, warnings (e.g. invalid schemes, oversized URI). Social handles are normalized to full URLs. Max URI size: 32768 bytes.

discord.description: Discord invite code or URL (e.g. abc123 or https://discord.gg/abc123)

image.description: Token image: data:image/* (base64), ipfs://, or https://

nsfw.description: Mark the logo NSFW (renderers blur it). Usually set from set_image's returned nsfw flag.

telegram.description: Telegram handle or URL (e.g. groupname or https://t.me/group)

twitter.description: Twitter/X handle or URL (e.g. @handle or https://twitter.com/handle)

name: build_metadata
